scenes.text: This shark may have been alive for nearly four hundred years.
Scientists estimated one Greenland shark was roughly three hundred ninety two years old.
To work it out, they radiocarbon dated the eye lenses of twenty eight females.
The results place Greenland sharks as the longest-lived vertebrates on Earth.
Females aren't even mature until they're around one hundred fifty.
Would you want to live for four hundred years?

title: This shark may be nearly 400 years old 🦈
caption: Scientists estimated that one Greenland shark was roughly 392 years old, using radiocarbon dating of eye lenses. That makes them the longest-lived vertebrates known! 🦈
